Usage: headroom [<command>] [flags]
   or: headroom [flags]

headroom shows which of this machine's Claude Code and Codex accounts has quota left, launches claude or codex on the account it decides, and continues any Claude Code session on the account that last drove it.

Bare, headroom is the board (see headroom board --help). Two things decide where a bare
headroom launch goes: the board's enter pins an account, and its a key turns automatic
placement on, so each bare launch takes the least-loaded account instead.

An account is a config dir: Claude Code's primary is ~/.claude and the others are
~/.claude-accounts/<email>; Codex's are ~/.codex and ~/.codex-accounts/<email>. Commands
that report — the board, limits, launches, refresh — cover every vendor on this machine
unless --vendor names one. Commands that act on one account — launch, resolve, accounts
add and remove — act on Claude Code unless --vendor says codex. login, sessions and
headless are Claude Code only.

Flags:
  -h, --help             Show context-sensitive help.
      --version          Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and
                         exit.

Arguments and flags of board, the default command:
      --vendor=VENDOR    Only this vendor's accounts; every vendor on this machine when absent (one
                         of: claude, codex).
      --compact          One row per account: each limit's percent and time to reset, every warning
                         at the end of the row.
      --json             Print the board as a JSON document after one refresh round.

Constraints:
  At most one of --compact, --json.

Commands:
  board                          The account board: every account's limits, live; also headroom
                                 accounts (default).
  accounts board                 The account board (default).
  accounts add <email>           Seed the dir for a new subscription.
  accounts remove [<account>]    Remove an extra account: its Keychain item and its dir.
  accounts ledger [<root>]       Spend against another home's ledger, and list the homes that share
                                 it.
  launch [<args> ...]            Run claude, or codex, on the account headroom decides.
  sessions [<args> ...]          Continue any Claude Code session on this machine, on the account
                                 that last drove it.
  limits                         Print what is known about every account's limits, read from disk
                                 alone.
  launches                       List the newest launches, or judge how automatic placement has
                                 done.
  login renew [<account> ...]    Renew the logins that end soon, or the named ones, one after
                                 another at this terminal (default).
  login start <account>          Start one account's sign-in for an approver elsewhere, and print
                                 its URL as JSON.
  login finish <account>         Send a started sign-in the code its page showed, from stdin, and
                                 print the verdict as JSON.
  login status <account>         Print one account's started sign-in as JSON.
  login cancel <account>         End one account's started sign-in while it waits for its code.
  headless list                  List every account's headless token: whether there is one, and when
                                 it ends (default).
  headless mint <account>        Mint a long-lived token for one account through claude setup-token.
  headless place                 Decide which account the next headless session spends, and record
                                 it.
  headless started <placement> <pid>
                                 Report the process a session placed by place runs as, so it counts
                                 while it runs.
  headless token <account>       Print one account's headless token, and nothing else.
  headless forget <account>      Forget one account's headless token.
  resolve [<account>]            Print an account's name, dir and kind, for shell preflight.
  refresh                        Ask the usage endpoint about every account that may be asked, and
                                 store the answers.
  check                          Verify the vendor facts headroom relies on, and its own state.
  version                        Print the build this binary is.

Configuration:
  Nothing needs configuring on a standard install. These variables re-point the defaults:

    HEADROOM_HOME                    everything home-derived, for both vendors (test isolation)
    HEADROOM_ACCOUNTS_ROOT           where Claude Code's extra account dirs live
    HEADROOM_PRIMARY_NAME            the name ~/.claude answers to (default: its email's local part)
    HEADROOM_LAUNCHER_FORMAT         how the board spells an account's launch command (%s = name)
    HEADROOM_CODEX_ACCOUNTS_ROOT     where Codex's extra homes live
    HEADROOM_CODEX_PRIMARY_NAME      the name ~/.codex answers to
    HEADROOM_CODEX_LAUNCHER_FORMAT   the board's Codex launch command
    HEADROOM_USAGE_URL, HEADROOM_CODEX_USAGE_URL   the usage endpoints

  A relative HEADROOM_HOME or accounts root, or a ~/.claude-accounts/.ledger naming no
  usable accounts root, makes every command refuse until it is fixed; headroom check says
  which.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why

Run "headroom <command> --help" for a command's details.
